caseStudies.title: Autonomous agents and distributed browser execution.
caseStudies.context: Mirai helps candidates discover opportunities, prepare applications and carry out browser tasks within a user-defined mandate. It connects professional profile data, documents, campaigns and application tracking to an autonomous agent operating the user's linked local Chrome.
caseStudies.owned: I designed, implemented and deployed the entire system: product definition, frontend, backend, data architecture, agent runtime, browser extension, billing, security, cloud infrastructure and technical documentation.

keyWork.title: Backend & data
keyWork.body: Implemented REST APIs, a modular domain architecture, PostgreSQL persistence, relational constraints, versioned migrations and typed request validation. Used transactions, advisory locks, row-level locking and deterministic identities to coordinate writes and prevent duplicate effects in critical operations.

keyWork.title: Applied AI
keyWork.body: Built the agent runtime with Google ADK, Vertex AI Agent Engine and Gemini inference. Integrated tool calling, MCP, persistent conversational sessions, context compaction, structured outputs, streaming and user intervention for controlled execution.

keyWork.title: Distributed browser automation
keyWork.body: Connected the cloud runtime to local Chrome through Playwright MCP, a browser model adapter, a workspace WebSocket and the WXT extension using the Chrome Debugger API/CDP. Managed workspace ownership, browser events, cancellation and controlled execution recovery.

keyWork.title: Product flows & documents
keyWork.body: Developed chat, campaign orchestration, application tracking, document ingestion, multimodal extraction, structured professional profiles and CV generation. Used persistent execution state, result reconciliation and event-driven updates through PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY and WebSockets.

keyWork.title: Payments & billing
keyWork.body: Integrated Paddle checkout and signed HMAC-SHA256 webhooks with a prepaid wallet and transactional ledger. Implemented idempotent payment processing, inference usage reservations and settlement, reconciliation and adjustments.

keyWork.title: Security & privacy
keyWork.body: Implemented JWT authentication with Neon Auth, resource-level authorization, account isolation, private object storage and short-lived signed URLs. Defined tool restrictions, protected the Mirai tab and kept execution within the candidate's mandate and intervention boundaries.

keyWork.title: Cloud & DevSecOps
keyWork.body: Deployed the web and API independently with Docker, Google Cloud Build, Artifact Registry and Cloud Run. Automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions, integration tests against Neon dev, CodeQL, Trivy, OIDC/WIF, migration gates, candidate revisions, health checks and traffic rollback.

keyWork.title: Engineering lifecycle
keyWork.body: Documented product requirements, C4 architecture, shared contracts, domain responsibilities, security, delivery and operations. Organized the implementation around a consistent end-to-end development lifecycle.

caseStudies.purpose: Independent, non-commercial project for applied research and end-to-end software engineering. Payment integrations demonstrate system engineering and do not constitute a commercial offering.

architecture.body: A TypeScript monorepo separates the Next.js web application, Express API and WXT browser extension, sharing Zod contracts and CV rendering components. Web and API are deployed as independent Cloud Run services. The API uses a modular monolith with domain modules, Neon PostgreSQL and Drizzle ORM, private S3-compatible object storage, Vertex AI and Paddle. The extension connects the user's local browser to the backend through the workspace WebSocket.
architecture.alt: Logical architecture of Mirai, connecting the web client, browser extension, modular API, agent runtime and external services.
architecture.caption: Logical overview of Mirai's architecture.

engineeringDecisions.title: Cloud agent needs local browser access
engineeringDecisions.body: An extension-backed WebSocket/CDP bridge connects the runtime to the candidate's own Chrome.

engineeringDecisions.title: Concurrent operations compete for ownership
engineeringDecisions.body: PostgreSQL locks and conditional state transitions coordinate the workspace and critical writes.

engineeringDecisions.title: Requests and provider events can repeat
engineeringDecisions.body: Idempotent identities, transactions and reconciliation protect persistence and billing.

engineeringDecisions.title: Execution or streaming can be interrupted
engineeringDecisions.body: Persistent state, checkpoints, cursors and controlled recovery preserve context where supported; disconnection cancels affected executions.

engineeringDecisions.title: Inference costs vary with usage
engineeringDecisions.body: Wallet reservations, transactional ledger and usage settlement account for the actual consumption.

engineeringDecisions.title: A release can break compatibility or traffic
engineeringDecisions.body: Migration gates, candidate revisions and health checks control promotion; verified rollback restores previous traffic.

caseStudies.title: A culinary operating system built end to end.
caseStudies.context: CookPilot connects a daily food decision to an actionable plan, shopping list, cooking session and progress record. Ingredients, recipes, menus, meal moments, days and weeks form a shared domain linked to nutrition, costs, reuse and cooking assistance. I built the product across the Flutter application, backend, data architecture, AI integrations, UX/UI and monetization.
caseStudies.owned: I led the entire product lifecycle as founder and lead engineer: product definition, system design, relational modeling, backend, mobile architecture, UX/UI, applied AI, billing, integrations, analytics and store releases.

keyWork.title: Backend & domain architecture
keyWork.body: Designed the Supabase/PostgreSQL backend with relational domains, Auth, RLS, Edge Functions, SQL RPCs, Storage and Realtime. Modeled ingredients, recipes, menus, days, weeks, shopping and cooking sessions around shared contracts and server-side business rules.

keyWork.title: Data consistency & state
keyWork.body: Developed atomic planning mutations, compact acknowledgments, revision-based persistence and optimistic updates. Structured shared state, serialized critical writes and reconciled remote snapshots in planning, recipe import and shopping flows to avoid conflicting representations.

keyWork.title: Financial & nutritional logic
keyWork.body: Centralized ingredient pricing and recipe cost comparisons in shared SQL functions, using canonical ingredient identities, quantities, unit conversion, serving scaling and price caching. Connected these calculations to planning, shopping and nutritional context.

keyWork.title: Applied AI & multimodal processing
keyWork.body: Integrated OpenRouter and LLM APIs with structured outputs, specialized prompts and backend validation. Developed recipe import from external sources, multimodal extraction, draft review, ingredient matching and typed actions that feed the same culinary domain.

keyWork.title: Cooking execution & real-time assistance
keyWork.body: Developed persistent cooking sessions, timers, pause and resume flows, contextual tools and voice assistance with streaming audio. Coordinated the session runtime, local state, remote persistence and usage accounting.

keyWork.title: Computer vision & native integration
keyWork.body: Implemented MediaPipe gesture recognition and native-to-Flutter communication for hands-free cooking interactions, alongside platform-specific authentication and mobile integrations.

keyWork.title: Payments & entitlements
keyWork.body: Integrated RevenueCat, Google Play Billing and Huawei IAP for subscriptions and consumable packs. Developed server-side entitlement management, verified store synchronization, idempotent purchase materialization, usage consumption and refunds.

keyWork.title: Media infrastructure
keyWork.body: Implemented Cloudflare R2, CDN and a shared Worker for media storage and delivery, including authorized short-lived upload tickets and temporary media handling for recipe import.

keyWork.title: Mobile & design systems
keyWork.body: Built the Flutter/Dart application with Riverpod, reusable components, typed state, navigation and platform-specific flavors. Designed the product's UX/UI system in Figma and implemented its interfaces across interconnected product flows.

keyWork.title: Analytics & delivery
keyWork.body: Integrated PostHog for product analytics, OneSignal for notifications, Google Sign-In and Credential Manager, and managed release workflows for Google Play and Huawei AppGallery. Structured analytics around product events and verified financial records.

caseStudies.title: Full-stack foundation for a recruiting platform.
caseStudies.context: JobMatch connects candidates, companies and recruiters through job discovery, applications and AI-assisted matching. I led the technical foundation of its MVP, covering authentication, user and company profiles, vacancies, applications, dashboards and backend infrastructure.
caseStudies.owned: I was responsible for technical product definition, architecture, implementation and handoff, collaborating with UX/UI and translating recruiting and business requirements into working software.

keyWork.body: Designed and implemented the core MVP for candidates, companies and recruiters, including authentication, profile management, vacancies, applications and dashboards.
Structured the PostgreSQL data model and Supabase backend with Row-Level Security, Auth and Edge Functions to support the platform's business logic and access boundaries.
Developed AI-assisted matching workflows using candidate data, job requirements and backend matching logic; the matching foundation was subsequently used in production.
Implemented the platform initially in Flutter Web and migrated it toward Next.js for a more advanced stage, working with the UX/UI team.
Supported technical planning and the product foundation for ProInnóvate / Startup Perú 12G, then completed the technical handoff for continued V1 development.

caseStudies.businessProof: The MVP was used by 100+ users. My technical and product contribution supported the foundation behind PEN 67,000 in funding awarded to the project through ProInnóvate / Startup Perú 12G. I delivered the technical foundation and matching workflow for continued development of V1.

caseStudies.owned: I owned the mobile/frontend work end to end: UX/UI redesign, Flutter implementation, mobile architecture, real-time map flows, native integrations, store releases and collaboration with backend, infrastructure and management teams.
